name: Plague Rat Belt (Greater)
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 213
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8th
Slot belt; Price 11,200 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This belt functions as a plague rat belt, except it grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity and Constitution. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, bear’s endurance, cat’s grace, neutralize poison, remove disease; Cost 5,600 gp
